name: New AXM Module
notes: Copy this folder, rename it (no leading underscore so the hub sees it), set a unique id, and build your screen inside index.html. It already speaks the hub bridge: ready/log/settings/save/shutdown. Set "audience": "machine" if this module is machine-native — it will auto-route into the hidden AI-Native layer so humans aren't bothered by it (it still passes the same permission gates). Optionally set "layer": "<layer-id>" to suggest a specific layer; the user's own assignment always wins.
